info.name: Tajer ID — Customer App API (trader + supplier, one app)
info.description:
# Tajer ID / Digital Commerce Integration — Customer App API

**One app, two workspaces.** The same mobile app serves the **trader** (buyer) and the **supplier** (seller). Which screens a user sees is decided at runtime by `organizations[].business_mode` from `GET /api/v2/bootstrap`:

| `business_mode` | What the app shows |
|---|---|
| `trader` | Trader workspace only — browse suppliers, drafts → orders, goods receipts, pay invoices |
| `supplier` | Supplier workspace only — manage catalog & prices, approve orders, ship, invoice, collect |
| `hybrid` | **Both**, with a workspace switcher in the app shell |

Legacy v1 equivalence: `users.type = buyer` → trader, `seller` → supplier (`users.b2b_workspace` overrides).

**There is no workspace-switch endpoint.** The active workspace is *client-side state*. The server enforces it per endpoint, and several endpoints accept `?workspace=` or `?role=` to scope the response to one side.

---

## Run order

1. `00 · Setup & Auth → Login` — stores `jwt` + `userId`
2. `01 · Bootstrap` — stores `orgId`, `businessMode`, `workspace`, `branchId`
3. Then any folder. Folders are prefixed by audience: **10–15 = trader**, **20–24 = supplier**, **30–33 = both**.

Most requests store the ids they create into collection variables, so the folders chain end-to-end.

---

## How this backend differs from what you expect

| | |
|---|---|
| **No `{status,data}` envelope** | Responses are bare: `{"purchase_order":{...}}`, or a raw Laravel paginator. Many mutations return **204 with an empty body**. |
| **Validation errors are `400`, never `422`** | `{"msg":"validation_error","bag":{"field":["msg"]}}` |
| **An invalid token is `400`, not `401`** | There's no auth middleware — controllers validate `user_id` against `users.jwt`. A dead session looks like `400 validation_error` with `bag.user_id`. |
| **`JSON_NUMERIC_CHECK` is on** | Every numeric-looking string becomes a JSON **number**. `"0501234567"` → `501234567`. IBANs, barcodes, codes — all of them. |
| **The `m_p` prefix** | To defend free text from the above, the backend prepends the literal `m_p` to `user.phone`, address `text`/`number`/`close_to`/`notes`, and chat `text`. **Strip it.** |
| **Lists carry `data[].formatted`** | v2 list rows are Eloquent models with the mobile payload nested under `formatted`. Parse that, not the row. |
| **60 requests/min per IP, globally** | Plus per-route throttles (login 10/min, dispute 6/min, account deletion 5/hour). |
| **Some 200s are failures** | Suspended login → `200 {"status":"failed"}`. Nafath off → `200 {"msg":"nafath_disabled"}`. |
| **Never hardcode the state machine** | `GET /purchase_orders/{id}` returns `allowed_transitions`, `reason_required_for`, `next_action`, `viewer_role`, `can_request_cancel`. Build buttons from those. |
| **Arabic is the default** | Missing/unknown `Accept-Language` → `ar`. |

The collection-level test script warns you in the Postman console whenever it sees any of these.

---

## Headers (set automatically by this collection)

- `Authorization: Bearer {{jwt}}` — collection-level auth (the server also accepts a raw `jwt:` header, the iOS convention)
- `X-Organization-Id: {{orgId}}` — on every `/v2` request; omitted, the server falls back to `primary_organization_id`
- `Accept-Language: {{lang}}` — `ar` or `en`
- `Accept: application/json`

---

## Permission codes

Returned per organization by `bootstrap`. **`is_owner: true` bypasses every check.**

```
organizations.view   organizations.manage   organization.edit    branches.manage
relationships.manage credit.manage          catalog.manage       pricing.manage
purchase_orders.manage  approvals.act       deliveries.manage    goods_receipts.manage
invoices.view        invoices.manage        due_schedules.edit
collections.manage   adjustments.manage
contracts.view       contracts.manage       contracts.approve
settlements.manage   shelf.manage           stock_counts.manage
internal_transfers.view  internal_transfers.manage
fleet.manage  fleet.routes.view  fleet.routes.manage  fleet.tracking.view
audit.view
```

## Workspace-gated endpoints

Violations return **`403 organization_workspace_not_allowed`**. `hybrid` passes both.

**Trader-only writes:** all `/purchase_drafts/*` · `POST /goods_receipts` · `POST /goods_receipts/{id}/dispute` · `POST /collections/claim` · `POST /post_invoice_returns`

**Supplier-only writes:** `POST|PATCH /delivery_notes/*` (create, status, cancel, reschedule, seals) · `POST /invoices` · `POST /invoices/proforma` · `PATCH /invoices/due_schedules/{id}` · `POST /collections` · `PATCH /collections/{id}/status` · `POST /adjustments` · `PATCH /adjustments/{id}/status` · `POST /pricing/price_lists` · `POST /pricing/price_items` · `PUT /relationships/{id}/credit` · `GET /delivery/tracking/supplier_fleet`

**Shared, scoped by `?role=`:** `/purchase_orders` · `/delivery_notes` · `/invoices` — `?role=trader|supplier`; **omit it and you get both sides**, which is what a hybrid inbox wants and a workspace screen does not.

**Shared, scoped by `?workspace=`:** `/ops/panel` · `/ops/quick_actions` · `/ops/documents` · `/action_center`. Default when omitted: `trader` mode → `trader`; **`supplier` *and* `hybrid` → `supplier`**. A hybrid org must send it explicitly.

exec: // Warn when the session/org context has not been captured yet.
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('jwt')) { console.warn('No jwt — run "00 · Setup & Auth → Login" first.'); }
// Global assertions that encode this API's quirks.
console.error('AUTH FAILURE disguised as 400 validation_error — the jwt is invalid/expired.');
console.error('WRONG WORKSPACE — this endpoint needs business_mode trader/supplier/hybrid to match.');
if (t && t.indexOf('"status":"failed"') !== -1) console.error('HTTP 200 but business failure — check body.status');
if (t && t.indexOf('"m_p') !== -1) console.info('response contains m_p-prefixed fields — strip the prefix client-side');

Returns `{user}` including `user.jwt` — the session token for every other call. The test script stores it.

A **suspended account returns HTTP 200** with `{"status":"failed","msg":"suspended user"}` — check `status` before treating it as success.

Errors: `401 invalid_email`, `401 invalid_password` (msg is localized text, not a code).

`phone`/`whatsapp` are optional — the server generates unique placeholders when omitted.

**Public. `throttle:6,1`.** E-mails a 6-digit code valid for 1 hour. **204.**
**Public. `throttle:10,1`.** Returns `{user:{id, jwt}}` — use that jwt for the reset call.

**Multipart — stays POST** because PHP only parses multipart bodies on POST.

Returns `{user}`. Errors `401 email_exists|phone_exists|company_name_exists`.

item.name: 01 · Bootstrap & Workspace  (shared)

request.description:
**The single call that decides which workspace UI to render.**

Returns:
- `user.workspace_type` — `trader` | `supplier` (derived: legacy `type=seller` → supplier, else trader; `users.b2b_workspace` overrides)
- `user.available_workspaces` — from the caller's memberships
- `organizations[].business_mode` — **`trader` | `supplier` | `hybrid`** — this is the real gate
- `organizations[].approved_workspaces` — which profiles passed review
- `organizations[].permissions[]` — drives button enablement (`is_owner: true` bypasses every permission)
- `organizations[].journey` — onboarding checklist (`state`, `next_best_action`, `trader.missing[]`, `supplier.missing[]`)
- `feature_flags` / `platform_flags` — which modules to hide

**There is no workspace-switch endpoint.** The active workspace is *client-side state*; the server enforces it per endpoint via `business_mode`. For a `hybrid` org you show a switcher and pass `?workspace=` / `?role=` where the endpoint accepts it.

The test script stores `orgId`, `businessMode`, `workspace` and `branchId`.

exec: // hybrid defaults to "supplier" server-side; override with ?workspace=

request.description: `{flags}` — the `platform_flags` subset. Callable before an organization exists.
`{user}` + the caller's memberships. Use for the org switcher.

item.description: Call `Bootstrap` immediately after login. Everything downstream depends on `orgId` + `business_mode`.

item.name: 02 · Onboarding  (shared)

request.description: `{organization, journey, profiles}` — drive the whole wizard from `journey`.

`profile_type`: **`trader` | `supplier`** — an organization can hold **both**, which is what makes it `hybrid`.

`supplier_nature` (supplier profiles only): `manufacturer` | `supplier` | `both`.

Call once per workspace the org wants. Each profile is reviewed independently — `bootstrap.organizations[].approved_workspaces` tells you which passed.
**This is how a trader-only org becomes hybrid** (or vice versa). `workspace`: `trader` | `supplier`.

exec: try { const v = b.branch.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("branchId", v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Upsert. **Note `iban`/`account_number` come back as *numbers* if they are all-digits** (`JSON_NUMERIC_CHECK`).

exec: try { const v = b.bank_account.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("bankAccountId", v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Returns `{msg, employee, temporary_password}`. The **roles you assign here produce the `permissions[]`** the app reads from bootstrap.

item.description: Wizard driven entirely by `bootstrap.journey`. An org holding **both** a trader and a supplier profile becomes `business_mode: hybrid` and sees both workspaces in the app.

item.name: 03 · Organization & Profile  (shared)

request.description: Perm **`organizations.manage`**. `business_mode`: `trader`|`supplier`|`hybrid` — **setting `hybrid` is what unlocks both workspaces in the app.**
Perm **`branches.manage`**. One of `name_ar`/`name_en` is required → else `400 branch_name_required`.
Perm `organization.edit`. jpg/jpeg/png/webp, ≤ 5 MB → `{msg, organization_id, field, file_path, file_url}`.
**Cursor pagination, not a paginator:** `{organization_id, items, has_more}` with `?limit=&before_id=`.

exec: try { const v = b.post.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("postId", v); } catch (e) {}

item.description: Same for both workspaces.

item.name: 04 · Home & Ops Panel  (workspace-aware)

request.description:
**This is the endpoint that makes trader and supplier look like different apps.**

`?workspace=supplier|trader`. Omitted, the server defaults: `business_mode=trader` → `trader`; `supplier` **or `hybrid`** → **`supplier`**. So a hybrid org *must* send `workspace` explicitly or it always lands on the supplier home.

Returns `{workspace, theme, kpis, attention, notifications, quick_actions, document_groups, user, organization, generated_at}`.

**`theme` is server-driven and differs per workspace:**

| | supplier | trader |
|---|---|---|
| `primary_color` | `#1E56A0` (blue) | `#F26A1F` (orange) |
| `secondary_color` | `#F26A1F` | `#1E56A0` |
| `accent_color` | `#0C2D57` | `#B24A0F` |
| `surface_color` | `#F5F8FB` | `#FFF8F2` |

`kpis` = `approvals`, `logistics`, `finance`, `overdue`, each with `label_ar`, `label_en`, `value`, `severity` (`ok`|`info`|`warn`|`danger`), `icon`.

`attention` and `document_groups` are **already filtered by the member's permissions** (owner sees all).

`{workspace, theme, quick_actions}` — for partial refresh.

Each action: `{key, label_ar, label_en, icon, workspace, permission, permission_alts[], route, group, priority, workspace_resolved}`, sorted by `group` then `priority` desc.

**Workspace-tagged catalogue:**

| key | workspace | permission |
|---|---|---|
| `create_purchase_draft` | **trader** | `purchase_orders.manage` |
| `confirm_goods_receipt` | **trader** | `goods_receipts.manage` (alt `deliveries.manage`) |
| `claim_payment` | **trader** | `collections.manage` (alt `invoices.manage`) |
| `create_delivery_note` | **supplier** | `deliveries.manage` |
| `dispatch_delivery` | **supplier** | `deliveries.manage` |
| `track_outbound_shipments` | **supplier** | `deliveries.manage` |
| `issue_invoice` | **supplier** | `invoices.manage` |
| `record_collection` | **supplier** | `collections.manage` |
| `confirm_collection` | **supplier** | `collections.manage` |
| `approve_purchase_order` | any | `approvals.act` (alt `purchase_orders.manage`) |
| `review_contract` | any | `contracts.view` (alts `contracts.manage`, `contracts.approve`) |
| `create_contract` | any | `contracts.manage` |
| `manage_shelves` | any | `shelf.manage` (alt `settlements.manage`) |

⚠️ **The `route` field still carries the pre-REST RPC paths** (`/v2/purchase_draft/store`). Key your navigation off **`key`**, not `route`.
`{workspace, theme, document_groups}` — the accordion menu, permission-filtered. Lazy-load it.

item.description: **Render the home screen from these responses, not from a hardcoded grid.** The theme, KPIs, quick actions and document menu all change with `?workspace=`.

item.name: 05 · Notifications & Action Center  (shared)

request.description:
Paginator **plus a top-level `unread_count`**. Note the page-size param is `per_page` here (max 100), not `limit`.

Row: `{id, type, event_code, entity_type, entity_id, title, body, text, text_ar, text_en, click_action, is_read, read_at, created_at}`.

Same rows as the web bell — reading in one place reads everywhere.
The prioritized "what needs you now" feed. **Workspace-aware** — trader and supplier get different items.

**Register with BOTH this and `PUT /api/auth/device_token`** — v1 `tokens` and v2 `push_tokens` are separate tables. Backend runs FCM HTTP v1.

`app_variant` should track the active workspace.

item.description: Shared feed; the **action center is workspace-filtered**.

item.name: 10 · TRADER · Find suppliers & relationships

request.description:
Paginator. **Parse `data[].formatted`**, not `data[]`.

`formatted`: `{id, display_name, business_mode, supplier_nature, status, profile_status, sectors[], relationship_id, relationship_status ("none" when absent), relationship_classification, active_contracts_count, has_active_contract, latest_contract{}, products_count, skus_count, branches_count, order_entry_ready}`.

⭐ **`order_entry_ready`** is the single boolean gating the trader's "Create order" CTA: relationship `approved`/`active` **and** ≥ 1 active contract.

item.name: Resolve price  ⭐ BEFORE ADDING A LINE

request.description:
```json
{ "sku_id": 55, "relationship_id": 12, "available_qty": 340.0,
  "pricing": { "matched": true, "source": "...", "scope_type": "relationship",
               "price_list_id": 4, "price_list_name": "...", "payment_term_id": 2,
               "currency_code": "SAR", "unit_price": 12.5, "final_price": 11.25,
               "unit_discount": 1.25, "discount_type": "percent", "discount_value": 10,
               "tax_included": false, "line_subtotal": 112.5 } }
```

**`pricing.matched == false`** (source `legacy_fallback`) means no price rule applies — **block the add-to-draft** and tell the trader to contact the supplier.

item.name: SKU picker (price + stock in one call)

request.description:
⭐ **The right picker for the order-entry screen** — returns resolved price *and* availability per SKU in a single call.

Needs `product_id` **or** `supplier_organization_id` → else `400 supplier_organization_id_or_product_id_required`.

item.description: Read-only for the trader. **Writing catalog/pricing is supplier-only** — see folder 20.

item.name: 12 · TRADER · Purchase drafts → orders  ⭐ CORE FLOW

request.description: **Trader workspace only** (`business_mode` must be `trader` or `hybrid`) → else `403 organization_workspace_not_allowed`.

Perm **`purchase_orders.manage`**, trader workspace. Quota `max_purchase_orders_per_month`.

**Upsert** — omit `draft_id` to create, send it to update. Safe to retry.

`qty` min 0.001.

- `sku_not_belong_to_draft_supplier`
- `qty_less_than_min_order_qty`
- `qty_not_matching_order_step`
- `insufficient_supplier_inventory`

`draft_delivery_note, next_action, viewer_role, allowed_transitions[], reason_required_for[], can_request_cancel, cancel_request{}, timeline[], lines[]`

item.name: 13 · TRADER · Incoming shipments & goods receipts

request.description: ⭐ **`?role=trader`** = shipments coming *to* this org. Omit it and you also get shipments it sent (hybrid).

exec: try { const v = b.data[0].formatted.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("deliveryNoteId", v); } catch (e) {}

request.description:
`{delivery_note}`:

`id, purchase_order_id, purchase_order_code, code, status, cancel_reason, cancel_reason_label, cancel_note, canceled_at, supplier_branch_id, trader_branch_id, dispatched_at, en_route_at, arrived_at, delivered_at, proof_file, notes, supplier_branch{}, trader_branch{}, subtotal, tax_total, grand_total, currency, route_stop{}, driver{id,name,phone}, vehicle{id,plate_number}, pickup_seal_numbers[], seals_match, lines[], goods_receipts_count`

`route_stop` = `{id, status, planned_arrival_time, actual_arrival_time, actual_departure_time, arrival_latitude, arrival_longitude, receiver_otp_status, proofs[]}`.

**`route_stop.proofs[]`** is the chain-of-custody trail (pickup photo + signature at the supplier, delivery photo + signature at the trader) — render it as the visual handoff timeline. **`seals_match`** is the tamper check.
⭐ The trader's "track my order" screen. **Poll at 5 s foreground / 30 s background / stop on dispose** — the global cap is 60 req/min.
The trader's post-dispatch / pre-receipt adjustment window.

Perms **`deliveries.manage` + `goods_receipts.manage`**, **trader workspace only**.

`proof_file` is a **path from `POST /api/v2/uploads`**, not a file.

`404 delivery_note_not_found_for_trader`, `500 goods_receipt_create_failed`.

exec: try { const v = b.goods_receipt.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("goodsReceiptId", v); } catch (e) {}

item.name: 14 · TRADER · Invoices, payments & returns

request.description: ⭐ **`?role=trader`** = invoices this org owes. `?role=supplier` = invoices it issued.

exec: try { const v = b.data[0].formatted.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("invoiceId", v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Includes **`due_schedules[]`** (the installment plan) and **`outstanding_amount`** — the two things the trader's payment screen is built on.

exec: try { const v = b.invoice.due_schedules[0].id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set("dueScheduleId", v); } catch (e) {}

request.description:
Perm `collections.manage` **or** `invoices.view`. **Trader workspace only.** `throttle:20,1`.

**This is "I paid — please confirm".** The supplier then confirms or rejects it (folder 24).

`payment_method` here is limited to `transfer` | `cash` | `cheque` (the supplier's own endpoint also allows `gateway`, `adjustment`).

Send `invoice_id` **or** `due_schedule_id` → else `400 invoice_or_due_schedule_required`.
`proof_file` = path from `POST /api/v2/uploads`.
`404 invoice_not_found_for_trader_claim`.
Shows `status` (`pending`/`confirmed`/`rejected`) so the trader sees whether the supplier accepted the claim.

request.description: `{sliders, categories, best_selling, most_viewed, discount, cart_count}`. Products are **scoped to the caller's `country_id`**.

⚠️ **Increments the view counter** — never prefetch from a list.

`401 product_not_same_country_as_user`.
**204.** Adds if absent, removes if present — flip local state optimistically.
`{carts, totals:{total,tax,cart}, addresses}`. **Buyers only** — a `seller` account gets `400 validation_error`.

⚠️ **Splits the cart by seller into one order per seller, decrements stock, and empties the cart.**

The returned `totals`/`seller_info` describe only the **last** seller processed. **Always re-fetch `GET /api/orders` afterwards** — including on the `401 insufficient_product_count` path, because some orders may already have been created.

**Never auto-retry this.**

`status` **required**: `all`|`pending`|`confirmed`|`processing`|`delivered`|`declined`.

Side auto-detected from `users.type`; `merchant` is always the other party.
⚠️ **Known backend quirk:** `items[]` returns product objects without the per-line `count`/`price` the controller computes. Don't rely on quantities here.
Paginator (20), newest first. **`text` is `m_p`-prefixed.** Fetching marks them read.
⚠️ **`sender_id` is NOT auto-filled — you must send it.** **204.** Broadcasts `BroadcastMsg` + FCM push.
Same rows as the v2 bell in the legacy shape `{id, type, action_id, text, timestamp}`. **Prefer `GET /api/v2/notifications`.**
